# Vendored: @mediapipe/tasks-vision

`vision_bundle.mjs` and `wasm/` are vendored from the
[`@mediapipe/tasks-vision`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mediapipe/tasks-vision)
npm package, version `0.10.14`, unmodified. Licensed under Apache-2.0 by
Google LLC — see https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe/blob/master/LICENSE.

These files are served same-origin from this repo (instead of from
`cdn.jsdelivr.net`) so hand tracking keeps working on networks, ad
blockers, or privacy extensions that block third-party CDN requests.

The hand-tracking model at `../../models/hand_landmarker.task` is vendored
the same way, from
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/hand_landmarker/hand_landmarker/float16/1/hand_landmarker.task,
also Apache-2.0.
